name: Sahelanthropus
description: (Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A nuclear-armed bipedal tank modified for a human operator, armed with a high-power railgun, guided missile launchers, retractable flexible nanofiber HF blades, and independent sensory drones deploying explosives, flamethrowers, and high-caliber machine guns. Its depleted uranium armor can be enriched by its internal reactor and detonated as a nuclear explosion. Ammo and missiles restock every 24 hours, and it self-repairs via nanomachines.
